specRevisions.change: R01 staged rule and coverage responsibilities.
Refine i32/bool boundary obligations and allocate numeric diagnostic/trap identities without changing language semantics.

corpusRevisions.change: Original authored i32/bool numeric corpus; independent mathematical expectations, no execution evidence.

identities.meaning: Ordinary lexical, grammar, naming, type relations, control flow and class construction MUST inherit fixed TS 7.0.2 unless an explicit necessary difference applies.
Source/declaration input MUST be TS; JS runtime fallback and architectural dynamic features MUST NOT be introduced.
Integer tokens MUST be read as exact mathematical values; untyped literals default to i32 or use an explicit context.
bool and boolean MUST be aliases; first-slice conditions and short circuit MUST operate on bool.
Wrapping i32 addition
i32 subtraction, multiplication and negation MUST wrap at 32 bits.
i32 division MUST truncate toward zero and nonzero remainder MUST have the dividend sign.
i32 shift counts MUST be i32 in 0..31; >> sign extends and >>> zero fills with i32 result.
The W1 slice MUST cover top-level i32/bool functions, initialized const/let, simple assignment, arithmetic/comparison, if/else, while, calls and return without reference allocation.
Forward calls and direct/mutual recursion MUST be permitted in the first slice.
Operands and arguments MUST evaluate left to right; first actual trap stops later evaluation; folding MUST preserve execution paths.
Function entry and every while condition check MUST each cost one Semantic Fuel before the event, including initial and final false checks.
Entry active depth MUST be one; excess depth MUST fail before a new frame enters, after explicit argument evaluation.
trap MUST terminate the request with structured failure, not kill the host, be caught by language catch or roll back prior effects; physical failures are Execution Abort.
Integer rules MUST generalize by width; isize/usize MUST use target DataLayout; number MUST alias f64.
Explicit calls MUST distinguish checked conversion, integer truncation/wrap and equal-width scalar bit reinterpretation; as is not numeric conversion.
Strict float MUST retain declared precision at every step, nearest/ties-even, subnormals, signed zero and no implicit FMA; arithmetic NaN is canonical, moves preserve raw bits.
Values/components MUST retain explicit identity, fixed layout, value copies and per-field equality, excluding padding; no inheritance.
Ordinary GC class copies MUST retain object identity; source compatibility and construction MUST follow TS rather than universal nominal assignment.
Strict null checks MUST stay enabled; native storage MUST be initialized before reads; nonnull assertions MUST NOT bypass actual safety checks.
Generics MUST specialize whole-program concrete arguments, reuse identical instances and allow ordinary recursion.
Unions MUST retain TS narrowing with statically typed representation, no implicit dynamic boxing or universal handwritten source tags.
Closures MUST capture logical bindings with shared writes, safe managed environments and persistent FunctionId.
Module source behavior MUST follow TS live bindings and project/source module detection; runtime failed initialization MUST not publish partial state or automatically retry.
Managed Exception MUST follow ordinary throw/catch/finally without a universal nominal base restriction, remaining separate from trap/Abort and excluded from Zig ABI/kernel.
T[]/Array<T> MUST be continuous homogeneous vectors, not sparse JS arrays or object dictionaries.
ReadSpan/Span MUST be borrowed views whose return/capture obey escape constraints.
Immutable UTF-8 storage and StringView MUST have an explicit mapping to TS observable text behavior.
Zig MUST NOT retain raw managed pointers; only explicit ABI-safe types cross the boundary and GC objects use Handle.
Compile-time markers MUST only express necessary intent not derivable from ordinary TS declarations/types/analysis.
Kernels MUST exclude managed allocation, GC references, exceptions, await, locks and escaping borrows; Query/Job access and effects are analyzed.
CPU parallel and reduction behavior MUST have an independent numerical/determinism relation, not strict Execution Equivalence.
Fast-math MUST have its own numerical relation, separate from strict bitwise Execution Equivalence.
GPU numerical/device nondeterminism MUST use an independent GPU contract rather than strict CPU/VM Execution Equivalence.
Full R01 MUST retain W3 general language, W4 CPU/fast-math, W5 GPU and all applicable MUST/MUST NOT coverage; first-slice completion is insufficient.

The decimal token denotes exactly 9007199254740993 = 2^53 + 1, beyond i32 and host f64 exact-integer precision; range rejection follows from the original token, not a rounded host number.

The inverse of -2^31 is 2^31; subtract 2^32 to obtain -2^31. Negating an already typed value wraps, unlike typing a positive literal.
